Help
the assistant is the IDE's AI coding agent. Describe what you want to build and it will scaffold, code, and iterate with you.
Modes
Discovery — new conversations start here. the assistant asks clarifying questions to nail down requirements before writing any code.
Plan — the assistant researches the codebase and proposes a plan WITHOUT editing files. Toggle with /plan. Best for big or risky changes.
Execute — the default working mode. the assistant writes code, runs tools, and applies changes, then verifies them.
Tips
• Type @filename to attach a project file as context (or drag & drop any file).
• Type / to browse every command.
• Use /plan to have the assistant research before making changes.
• Use /undo to revert the last AI turn's file changes if it goes off track.
• Use /compact to compress context when the conversation gets long.
• Be specific — "Add a login page with email/password and Google OAuth" beats "add auth".
Press Cmd+/ (Ctrl+/ on Windows/Linux) to view all keyboard shortcuts.

Settings
Default model Not set
The model the assistant uses when a mode-specific model isn't set.
Plan-mode model Default (M Free)
The model used in plan mode. Falls back to the default model when unset.
Execute-mode model Default (M Free)
The model used in execute mode. Falls back to the default model when unset.
Commit-message model Default (M Free)
The model that writes commit messages. Falls back to a fast default when unset.
Compaction model Default (M Free)
The model that summarizes older messages when the conversation nears its context limit. Falls back to a fast default when unset.
Mode Execute
Plan mode researches and proposes without editing files; execute mode writes code.
Reasoning effort plan: medium · execute: medium
How hard the assistant thinks, set per mode using each mode's model-native levels (e.g. high/xhigh); also scales the agent loop budget.
Max tool iterations 100
Upper bound on the tool calls the assistant runs in one turn before it pauses for you.
Auto-fix On
After AI edits, re-run type-check and lint and feed any errors back so the assistant fixes them.
Auto-commit Every 5s
Automatically commit your work a set number of seconds after the last file change — on by default (5s; 0 = off), and it waits until the assistant finishes its turn before committing. Each change restarts the countdown, then it pauses after committing so a clean tree is never re-committed.
Hooks In project settings
Shell commands that run before tool actions and can gate them — for example previewing a change before the assistant overwrites or deletes a file. Configure them in your project's agent settings file.
Auto-approve commands Off
Skip the 'Proceed?' confirmation before the assistant runs a bulk/destructive command (a hard reset, a recursive delete, an in-place edit). Network access still follows the project's allowlist unless Full access is on.
Notification sounds 7 of 10 events enabled
Per-event notification sounds for responses, errors, file changes, and more.
Timestamps On
Show the time on every chat message and event. Off by default; your own messages and critical events always show it. This device only.
Slash commands
Context
/clear
Clear conversation
/compact
Compress context to free space
/cost
Show token usage & share of the project's AI allowance
/skills [query]
Browse & load project skills
Code
/commit
Commit current changes
/explain [@file | topic]
Explain code (e.g. /explain @file)
/lint [path]
Run linter and fix issues
/test [query | all]
List and run the project's tests
/undo
Revert last AI turn's file changes
/scripts [query]
Browse & run saved scripts and built-in actions
/run <name> [--option value]
Run a saved script or built-in by name
/autocommit <seconds>
Auto-commit N seconds after the last file change (0 cancels)
/autofix
Toggle auto-fix after AI file changes
/autoapprove
Toggle auto-approving destructive commands (skip the Proceed confirm)
Collaborate
/share [viewer | commenter | editor | owner]
Create a public share link for this project
Model
/model [name | --plan | --execute | --commit | --compact]
Switch the model for any mode (plan, execute, commit messages, compaction)
/plan
Toggle plan/execute mode
/maxloops <n>
Set max tool iterations
/effort [--plan|--execute] [level]
Pick reasoning effort per mode from the model's own levels
Settings
/settings
View & change the assistant's settings
/sounds
Notification sounds
/timestamps [on | off]
Show or hide the time on chat messages and events
/mic
Choose the dictation engine (on-device / browser native)
/dictate
Choose the dictation engine (alias for /mic)
Support
/help
Workflow guide & tips
/report [title]
Report a bug or send feedback
/bug [title]
Report a bug (alias for /report)
/version
Show the app version
